fields.name: demo_moves
fields.description: The ordered list of menu letters, one per leg of the demonstration video, written at the first decision step and copied unchanged at every later step. A leg runs from one highlighted target to the moment a different target becomes highlighted (the gripper has reached the next target). Count one leg at EVERY change of the highlighted target: the number of letters equals the number of highlight changes in the demonstration, including legs that return to a target already visited, legs lasting only a few frames, and a change that appears only in the last demonstration frame; never merge or skip a leg because the gripper comes back to where it was. A frame showing two targets highlighted at once is the change frame: the leg ends there and the next leg starts there, the newly highlighted target being the new one. Letter for a leg: compare the x of the new target with the x of the previous target; smaller x is RIGHT, larger x is LEFT. Then take the leg's frames: exactly the demonstration frames whose single highlighted target is the leg's starting target, after the frame where that target first became highlighted (for the first leg that opening frame is the very first demonstration frame, so its frames run from the second frame up to the first change) and before the first frame in which the next target appears highlighted (a two-target frame is that closing frame and is excluded). Frames at or after the closing change frame belong to the following leg, never to this one. The reference stick is the one cube whose x lies between the x of the starting target and the x of the new target. In each of the leg's frames compare the gripper's y with that cube's y in the same frame (the cube may shift a few pixels when brushed): gripper y smaller than the cube's y means it passed the backward side, larger the forward side. The gripper's y relative to the new target and its travel in the next leg are irrelevant. LEFT+backward=A, RIGHT+forward=B, LEFT+forward=C, RIGHT+backward=D. The list has as many letters as legs in the demonstration, and it equals the sequence of recorded subgoals of the episode. Written as a single-quoted list, comma and space between letters, never double quotes. e.g. ['A', 'B', 'A', 'D']

fields.name: legs_done
fields.description: Number of execution legs the robot has completed so far, i.e. the index of the decision step counting from zero: 0 at the first decision step, 1 at the second, 2 at the third, and so on. It is the index into demo_moves of the subgoal to issue now. e.g. 1
